contractCases.expected: Root/Addon are div role=group. Addon align defaults inline-start and accepts inline-end/block-start/block-end. Its default onClick focuses the first descendant input in its parent, except when target.closest(button) exists. It does not target textarea. Because {...props} is spread after onClick, a caller onClick replaces this default handler. Input/Textarea delegate actual Input/Textarea. InputGroupButton defaults type=button, variant=ghost, size=xs; sizes xs/sm/icon-xs/icon-sm. InputGroupText is span, not an automatic label or describedby relation.

Native input editing and Button activation remain with the composed components. Addon div is not keyboard focusable or a substitute for a label. This reference provides a real label and persistent described help; its clear Button is a caller action. Clicking decorative addon text can focus the input, but clicking its nested Button must preserve the Button interaction. Textarea compositions use their own visible label; addon does not promise textarea focusing.
